name: Analenzor User Behavior Analytics
author: analenzor

sections.description:
آنالنزور یک افزونه سبک ولی قدرتمند برای تحلیل رفتار کاربران و ضبط نشست‌ها در وردپرس است.
با استفاده از این پلاگین می‌توانید رفتار کاربران خود (کلیک‌ها، اسکرول‌ها، مسیر حرکت) را مشاهده کرده و برای بهینه‌سازی نرخ تبدیل و تجربه کاربری از آن استفاده کنید.
همچنین با نام‌های Analenzor، analenzor، آنالنزور نیز شناخته می‌شود.

Analenzor is a lightweight yet powerful plugin for user behavior analytics and full session replay.
It helps you understand how users interact with your site (clicks, scrolls, sessions) and optimize conversions.
Also known as Analenzor, analenzor, آنالنزور.

External Services

This plugin connects to the “Analenzor Dashboard” API to provide user behavior analytics, session replay, and SEO checks.

  • The script is loaded from: https://dashboard.analenzor.com/api/script
  • The tracking script sends anonymized user behavior data (clicks, scrolls, session duration, etc.) to Analenzor servers for analytics purposes.
  • Data is collected only after the site owner configures and activates the plugin.
  • This service is provided by Analenzor:
    • Terms of Service: https://dashboard.analenzor.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://dashboard.analenzor.com/privacy

Features

  • Session Replay (record and replay user activity)
  • User Interaction Tracking (clicks, scrolls, mouse movements)
  • Lightweight, privacy-friendly, and fast
  • RTL and Persian (فارسی) support
  • Designed for behavior analytics and conversion optimization
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/analenzor-user-behavior-analytics directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Analenzor’ settings page to configure the plugin and start tracking.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with session replay and click/scroll tracking.
